option.gammaplus.gamma_enabled.tooltip: Master toggle for the brightness boost. Also bound to the G key.
option.gammaplus.gamma_level.tooltip: Brightness factor. 100% is a full bright-tone blend; higher values push past the lightmap clamp for maximum visibility in the dark.
option.gammaplus.nv_enabled.tooltip: Master toggle for the custom Night Vision effect. Also bound to the N key.
option.gammaplus.nv_intensity.tooltip: Strength of the Night Vision blend. Floored at 10% so an enabled effect is always visible.
option.gammaplus.dynamic_enabled.tooltip: Ramp brightness automatically as your surroundings get darker. Also bound to the L key.
option.gammaplus.dynamic_high.tooltip: Brightness ramped to in full darkness — deep caves, or night on the surface.
option.gammaplus.dynamic_normal.tooltip: Baseline brightness in full daylight on the surface. 0% leaves vanilla brightness untouched.
option.gammaplus.dynamic_rate.tooltip: How quickly brightness adapts. Higher is snappier. Brightening is slower than dimming, mimicking eye adaptation.
option.gammaplus.dynamic_cave.tooltip: Sky light at or below this counts as fully underground. Raise it to trigger under thinner cover.
option.gammaplus.dynamic_night.tooltip: World sky darkness at or above this counts as full night. 3 also catches thunderstorms.
text.gammaplus.gamma.shader_warning: ⚠ Gamma Boost has no effect while a shader pack is active — use Night Vision instead.
text.gammaplus.nightvision.shader_note: ✓ Night Vision works with Iris shader packs.
text.gammaplus.dynamic.shader_note: ↳ Shaders are active, so Dynamic Lighting drives Night Vision instead of brightness.
